import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.Set;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    public static boolean checkProperty(int[] f, int p, int k) {
        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            if (f[(k * i) % p] != (k * f[i]) % p) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static int recursiveCount(List<Integer> f, int p, int k, int i) {
        if (i == p) {
            int[] arr = f.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
            return checkProperty(arr, p, k) ? 1 : 0;
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < p; j++) {
            f.add(j);
            total += recursiveCount(f, p, k, i + 1);
            f.remove(f.size() - 1);
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static int mainFunction(int p, int k) {
        int count = 0;
        Set<Integer> visited = new HashSet<>();
        for (int j = 0; j < p; j++) {
            if (!visited.contains(j)) {
                count++;
            }
            int current = j;
            while (!visited.contains(current)) {
                visited.add(current);
                current = (current * k) % p;
            }
        }
        int exponent = count - (k != 1 ? 1 : 0);
        long result = powMod(p, exponent, MOD);
        return (int) result;
    }

    public static long powMod(long base, int exp, int mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long curr = base % mod;
        for (int i = 0; i < exp; i++) {
            result = (result * curr) % mod;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = scanner.nextInt();
        int k = scanner.nextInt();
        System.out.println(mainFunction(p, k));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
